entries.7ce807c56fd428a6: The holding company of a group that integrates the manufacture and sale of asphalt products for road paving with the contracting of paving work.
entries.84bf5c91a65f107c: This business is not included in reportable segments and consists of real estate leasing conducted by the company and some consolidated subsidiaries, and non-life insurance agency business conducted by consolidated subsidiary Anzen Kaihatsu Co., Ltd., among others. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥304 million.
entries.bb205ac9fcd38bb8: Business in road paving products, technologies and construction works.
entries.e554776db09ff2fd: This is a business in which consolidated subsidiary Nichireki Co., Ltd. manufactures and sells road paving materials, including asphalt emulsions and modified asphalt. Some consolidated subsidiaries and overseas affiliates also sell products of Nichireki Co., Ltd. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥24,721 million.
entries.ee60af45f1de8e60: This is a business in which 37 consolidated subsidiaries, including Nichireki Doro Co., Ltd., and some overseas affiliates undertake contracts for paving and waterproofing works. Revenue from external customers for the fiscal year ended March 2026 was ¥50,827 million, making it the Group's largest business.
